editorial:
Imagine being a rich guy with everything, only to have a golf ball smack you in the head and wipe your memory. That is exactly what happens to Krister Dahl. Once he forgets who he is, he runs right into his ex-wife and falls head-over-heels in love with her all over again. It is a sweet and funny setup because while he is being genuine, she is totally confused. She cannot tell if he is actually suffering from amnesia or if he is just playing a mean trick on her. The whole vibe is lighthearted and breezy, making it a perfect pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon when you just want to smile.

What really makes this work is how the movie handles the irony of Krister's situation. As he gets his life back, he realizes he was actually a pretty terrible boss who messed up his own company. Seeing him learn from his past mistakes while trying to win back his wife is genuinely touching. The pacing is quick, and the chemistry between the leads feels natural. If you can find a way to stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or rent it on Apple TV, you should definitely do it. Otherwise, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for fans of old-school romance.
endingExplained: By the end, Krister fully recovers his memory and realizes how much of a jerk he was before the accident. Instead of going back to his old ways, he uses his new perspective to fix his business and treat people with kindness. He finally proves to his ex-wife that his love for her is real, not a joke. They reconcile and decide to start their relationship over, ending the movie on a happy, romantic note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic romantic comedies with a funny twist.
